title: 5x faster Edge Functions: V8 isolates to Firecracker MicroVMs
summary: Netlify announced a 5x performance improvement in their Edge Functions by migrating from V8 isolates to Firecracker MicroVMs, leveraging AWS's open-source virtualization technology for better isolation and faster cold start times at the edge.
problem_solved: Addresses slow cold start times and limited isolation in serverless edge function execution environments.
why_valuable: Enables developers to run edge functions with near-native performance while maintaining strong security isolation, significantly improving user experience for globally distributed applications.
